post.title: Why timeshares are so hard to sell, in real numbers
post.ig:
Even the FTC says timeshares are hard to sell. Here's why.

The average new timeshare sold for $24,740 in 2025 (ARDA).
Marriott Vacations Worldwide spent $943 million on marketing and sales in 2025, on about $1.8 billion in company-reported contract sales: more than half.
Average yearly maintenance fees rose from $1,120 in 2021 to $1,550 in 2025 (ARDA), and resale buyers take those on too.

Sources: FTC consumer alert (March 2024), ARDA State of the Vacation Timeshare Industry (2022-2026 editions), Marriott Vacations Worldwide FY2025 results.
News and education, not financial advice.
